title: Physical count
saved: Physical count {{no}} recorded. It now shows in the Warehouse Inventory Statement.
newSubtitle: Type what you counted next to each product. Recording a count does not change stock; it appears in the stock report (Physical Count and Inventory Variance).
bookNote: Book = quantity the books showed at the end of {{date}}. Difference = Counted − Book (+ surplus, − shortage).

form.hint: Leave a product empty if it was not counted. Type 0 if it was counted and nothing is there.
form.pickWarehouse: Choose a warehouse and a count date to load its products.
form.noProducts: This warehouse has no products yet.
form.nothingCounted: Type the counted quantity of at least one product.
form.badQty: Counted quantities must be 0 or more.
